address: Altınyunus, 3435. Sokak No:66, Çeşme, Izmir, 35930, Türkiye
bio: The moment meat lovers walk into this cosy establishment with its delightful terrace at the back, their spirits are lifted. An array of cuts, expertly prepared by the butcher, awaits in the refrigerated display counter, and in the background, you can see the barbecue where the magic happens. Options include marinated ribeye, perfectly rare and with a crispy fat cap, as well as succulent burgers in house-made buns. What you see is what you get, and it's absolutely delicious!
